scope: original STBN table CPU spectral verification only

protocol.control_rng: numpy PCG64, SeedSequence([seed, 1398030926, dimension, control_index]); control_index=0 permutation, 1 iid
protocol.normalization: sum band FFT power / sum all non-DC FFT power, pooled over all independent slices or pixel histories and dimensions within one seed
protocol.spatial_band: DFT on 8x8 slice, integer-frequency modes 0<kx^2+ky^2<=2; remove each slice DC; no window (toroidal table)
protocol.temporal_band: DFT on length16 history per fixed pixel, integer-frequency modes |kt|=1; remove each history DC; no window
protocol.gate_scope: Each of 5 thresholds, both spectral axes and both controls separately. Correlation is flattened raw rank values, all off-diagonal dimension pairs, separately for every seed.
protocol.adoption_boundary: A pass supports only low-frequency suppression/uniform rank coverage for these original tables. No renderer quality, GPU, energy, frame-performance, runtime block-rotation or general SOTA claim. Fixed 16-frame rank period is outside these gates and remains a runtime-sampling limitation.
